summary: Actinium Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K on June 18, 2026, disclosing submission of a compliance plan to NYSE American after receiving a notice on May 27, 2026, for non-compliance with continued listing standards under Section 1003(a)(ii) of the NYSE American Company Guide, which requires at least $4.0 million in stockholders' equity if losses occurred in three of the last four fiscal years. The plan outlines actions management intends to take to restore compliance. No specific terms (price, premium, stake) are stated. The filing does not name any advisor. The structural note is the listing standard deficiency and the compliance plan submission. Watch for NYSE American's acceptance of the plan and the company's ability to regain compliance within the allowed cure period.
